searchText: Is there a (tentative) spec for adding withdrawals to the JSON-RPC? Not all clients include the withdrawals object in response to block queries and I'd like to know what the right behavior here. Specifically, geth does not include withdrawals while nethermind does. I'm doing some interop testing and seeing issues as lighthouse makes block queries for its beacon API and it expects withdrawals to be available via block JSON-RPC. cc: <@543900561460822016> <@277500722655002624> We do (when we include transactions, so only on inclTx=true) (might also be a relatively recent change on withdrawals-timestamp) what branch are you looking at? I'm using lightclient's PR - https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/25838 and I don't see that implemented https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/334 https://github.com/lightclient/go-ethereum/tree/withdrawals-timestamp thanks!

Is there a (tentative) spec for adding withdrawals to the JSON-RPC? Not all clients include the withdrawals object in response to block queries and I'd like to know what the right behavior here. Specifically, geth does not include withdrawals while nethermind does. I'm doing some interop testing and seeing issues as lighthouse makes block queries for its beacon API and it expects withdrawals to be available via block JSON-RPC.

cc: <@543900561460822016> <@277500722655002624>

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: We do (when we include transactions, so only on inclTx=true)
